decision_scope: nonterminal research-loop decision; not one of the final project decisions
decisive_observations: V1 contact sheets contain 20 endpoint-exclusive 2 fps frames, while the physical runner would supply 21 endpoint-inclusive frames.
The nominal 4 fps runner path uses floor(30/4)=7-frame stepping, yielding 43 frames at approximately 4.286 fps rather than an exact 41-frame 4 fps grid.
The V1 analyzer can pass all-unknown, all-negative, or otherwise single-class operational outputs because it lacks usable-class-support gates.
The V1 parser accepts prose-wrapped JSON and label-inconsistent fields for unknown and not_relevant outputs.
The V1 analyzer does not authenticate raw records, frame identities, prompt/config/model bindings, or equal model inputs across repeats.
Identical greedy repeats measure same-process reproducibility, not independent semantic stability.
The V1 review was pre-outcome but not blinded to legacy strata or independent of sample selection.
The twelve-clip targeted sample is too small and biased to authorize a full 1475-unit run from a pass alone.
interpretation: No V1 outcome exists and no negative result was overwritten. The invalidation is a pre-execution falsification of the measurement protocol. V2 must repair exact input identity, schema validation, artifact authentication, degenerate-pass logic, semantic screening, and authorization scope before compute is requested again.
next_action: Freeze and independently audit AEQ_ORACLE_PREFLIGHT_V2. A V2 pilot pass may authorize only a larger representative audit or another explicitly justified stage, not the full oracle automatically.
